name: HR, People & Training
short: HR and payroll, recruiting, staff scheduling, employee portals, and learning platforms that take paperwork off your managers' plates.
intro: Hiring, onboarding, scheduling, paying, and training people generates more paperwork than almost any other part of a business. These solutions connect the employee lifecycle from application to payroll so managers spend their time leading people instead of processing forms.

solutions.name: HR & Payroll Management Platform
solutions.tagline: Employee records, time, benefits, and payroll consolidated into one system.
solutions.text: A centralized HR and payroll platform that consolidates employee records, time tracking, benefits administration, and payroll processing into one system instead of five disconnected tools. Employee self-service lets staff request time off, view pay stubs, and update their own information, automated payroll runs handle tax calculations and direct deposit, and compliance tracking flags expiring certifications or required documentation before it becomes a liability. The platform integrates with your existing time clock or scheduling system, and reporting dashboards give HR and leadership visibility into headcount, labor cost, and turnover without exporting data from four different logins.
for: Growing teams with HR spread across several tools
Businesses with hourly staff and complex time rules
features: Personal, job, pay, and document data in one place.
Taxes, deductions, and direct deposit on schedule.
Hours flow from the time clock into payroll.
Pay stubs, time off, and personal updates without HR.
Headcount, labor cost, overtime, and turnover.
problems: HR data spread across spreadsheets and logins
Payroll errors from manual time entry
Time-off requests lost in email
No clear view of labor costs
faq: Should HR and payroll be in the same system?
Usually yes. A single system removes duplicate data entry between HR records and payroll, which is where many payroll errors begin.
Can you connect our existing time clock?
Yes. We connect most time clock and scheduling systems so approved hours flow directly into payroll.
Do you replace our payroll provider?
Not necessarily. We often keep a trusted provider like Gusto or ADP and connect it to the rest of your systems.

solutions.name: Applicant Tracking & Recruiting Platform
solutions.tagline: Post once, screen faster, schedule interviews automatically, and hire before competitors do.
solutions.text: An applicant tracking system that posts jobs to your careers page and major job boards, collects applications in one pipeline, and moves candidates forward automatically. Knockout questions and AI-assisted screening surface qualified applicants, interview scheduling happens through self-booking links, and candidates get timely status updates so none are left wondering. Offer letters are generated and signed electronically, and hired candidates flow straight into onboarding and payroll.
for: Growing companies hiring across many roles
Teams losing candidates to slow responses
features: One posting distributed to Indeed, LinkedIn, and more.
Knockout questions and AI-assisted resume review.
Candidates book open times on the hiring team's calendars.
Automatic status updates by email and text.
E-signed offers that create the new hire record.
problems: Applications scattered across job boards and inboxes
Good candidates accept other offers while you schedule
Hiring managers screen resumes by hand
Applicants never hear back
faq: What is an applicant tracking system?
An ATS collects job applications from every source into one pipeline and helps the hiring team screen, interview, communicate with, and hire candidates efficiently.
Is AI resume screening fair?
AI should assist, not decide. We configure screening around job-related criteria, keep humans in charge of decisions, and review outcomes for bias.
Can candidates apply by text?
Yes. Text-to-apply and short mobile applications are especially effective for hourly roles.

solutions.name: Staff Scheduling & Time Clock System
solutions.tagline: Build schedules in minutes, fill open shifts fast, and pay exactly the hours worked.
solutions.text: A scheduling and time tracking system for hourly teams that builds schedules from templates and forecasted demand, publishes them to employees' phones, and lets staff swap shifts and pick up open ones with manager approval. Mobile clock-in with geofencing or kiosk photo verification prevents buddy punching, overtime and break rules are enforced as the schedule is built, and approved timesheets flow straight into payroll.
features: Staff see shifts and changes on their phones.
Coverage handled by staff with manager approval.
Overtime, breaks, and predictive scheduling rules.
Approved hours sent straight to payroll.
problems: Schedules built in spreadsheets and posted on a wall
Managers spend hours finding shift coverage
Buddy punching and timesheet errors
Surprise overtime costs
faq: How does geofenced clock-in work?
Employees can only clock in on their phone when they are within a set distance of the work location, which reduces time theft without extra hardware.
Can the system help control overtime?
Yes. Managers see projected overtime while building the schedule and get alerts before an employee crosses the threshold.
Does it work for multiple locations?
Yes. Each location has its own schedule, with staff able to work across locations and combined labor reporting.

solutions.name: Employee Portal & Intranet
solutions.tagline: One home for company news, policies, forms, requests, and the tools staff use daily.
solutions.text: A branded employee portal that gives every team member one place to find announcements, policies, procedures, forms, benefits information, and links to the tools they use. Requests for IT help, equipment, time off, or reimbursements are submitted through simple forms that route to the right approver, onboarding checklists guide new hires through their first weeks, and a searchable directory helps people find who does what. Mobile access means frontline staff stay informed too.
for: Companies with remote, hybrid, or frontline staff
Growing teams where information lives in email
features: Targeted by location, team, or role.
IT, HR, facilities, and finance requests routed automatically.
Step-by-step tasks for new hires and their managers.
Find colleagues by team, skill, or location.
Frontline staff included without company email.
problems: Employees cannot find the latest policy or form
Requests get lost in email and chat
New hires ask the same questions repeatedly
Frontline workers miss company updates
faq: What is the difference between an intranet and an employee portal?
The terms overlap. An intranet usually focuses on news and documents, while a portal adds self-service requests, onboarding, and links into HR and IT systems. We typically build both together.
Can frontline employees without email use it?
Yes. Mobile apps and SMS login let deskless workers access the portal on their phones.
Can we build it on Microsoft 365?
Yes. SharePoint and Teams are a strong foundation for companies already using Microsoft 365.

solutions.name: Learning Management System (LMS) Deployment
solutions.tagline: Onboarding, compliance, and certification training delivered and tracked automatically.
solutions.text: A fully configured learning management platform used to onboard new employees, deliver ongoing compliance training, or run certification programs, complete with course-building tools, progress tracking, automated reminders for incomplete training, and reporting dashboards for managers and HR. This offering includes initial setup, custom branding, content migration or creation, and integration with existing HR systems so training completion data flows automatically into employee records.
for: Franchises and multi-location brands standardizing training
features: Videos, quizzes, and documents organized into paths.
Courses assigned by role, location, or hire date.
Learners and managers nudged on overdue training.
Completion data synced to employee records.
problems: Training tracked on paper sign-in sheets
No proof of compliance training during audits
Every location trains differently
Managers chase employees to finish courses
faq: What is an LMS?
A learning management system delivers online courses, tracks who completed what, and reports on training across your organization.
Can we sell courses to customers with an LMS?
Yes. Many LMS platforms support e-commerce, so you can sell courses, memberships, or certifications to external learners.
Can you create the course content?
Yes. We can convert existing manuals and slide decks into online courses, or produce new content with your subject matter experts.
